<h1>Stay</h1>
<p><a class="arrow-down" href="stay#content">Arrow Down</a></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="content" class="taipan-contentpanel-panel ">
  <div class="panel-background-image" ></div>
  <div class="panel-constrain">
    <div class="panel-block">
      <div class="panel-cell">
<h2>INDIVIDUALLY DESIGNED<br />BEACHFRONT VILLAS</h2>
<p>Spread sparingly along the islands long beach, our 5 beach front villa&rsquo;s offer absolute privacy and stunning ocean views. Embracing Papua New Guinea / African design, each generous, open-plan villa features a private deck, tropical garden, offering first row seats of the best entertainment - nature itself.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="taipan-contentpanel-panelset-0-panel-2" class="taipan-contentpanel-panel bg-image-text-right">
  <div class="panel-background-image"  style="background-image: url('files/media/thumbcache/739/e9c/IMG_8603---Haus-Mawu.JPG');"></div>
  <div class="panel-constrain">
    <div class="panel-block">
      <div class="panel-cell">
<h2>Haus<br />Mawu</h2>
<p><span>House Mawu was designed exclusively by Roy and is the largest and more luxurious of all the accommodation. The self contained villa is located on the hillside overlooking the big lagoon. It has two queen&nbsp;bedrooms, two starlit bathrooms, open plan kitchen lounge area with a stone fire place, library and loft with two single beds.</span></p>
<p><a class="button" href="stay/haus-mawu">More</a></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="taipan-contentpanel-panelset-0-panel-3" class="taipan-contentpanel-panel bg-image-text-left">
  <div class="panel-background-image"  style="background-image: url('files/media/thumbcache/03d/497/27b/Screen-Shot-2018-08-15-at-3.32.03-pm.png');"></div>
  <div class="panel-constrain">
    <div class="panel-block">
      <div class="panel-cell">
<h2>Lagoon<br />Hut</h2>
<p>Lagoon hut is located toward the North East side of the island, a stone throw from the waters edge with views overlook the Big Lagoon and Coral Sea.</p>
<p><a class="button" href="stay/lagoon-hut">More</a></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="taipan-contentpanel-panelset-0-panel-4" class="taipan-contentpanel-panel bg-image-text-right">
  <div class="panel-background-image"  style="background-image: url('files/media/thumbcache/009/288/efd/Kwila-Hut-on-the-Stay-Page.jpg');"></div>
  <div class="panel-constrain">
    <div class="panel-block">
      <div class="panel-cell">
<h2>Kwilla<br />Hut</h2>
<p><span>Kwila hut is an open plan, hand crafted timber house, shaded under a canopy of coastal foliage with views to the sea. Featuring hand crafted benches and polished floors made from deep chocolate Daintree teak or 'Kwila'.</span></p>
<p><a class="button" href="stay/kwilla-hut">More</a></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="taipan-contentpanel-panelset-0-panel-5" class="taipan-contentpanel-panel bg-image-text-left">
  <div class="panel-background-image"  style="background-image: url('files/media/thumbcache/02c/847/4ba/tropical-island-accomodation.jpeg');"></div>
  <div class="panel-constrain">
    <div class="panel-block">
      <div class="panel-cell">
<h2>Beach<br />Hut</h2>
<p><span>Barefoot, bleached and castaway, the Beach hut is an open plan, aesthetic drift wood accommodation. Situated right on the beach and some distance from the main complex,&nbsp;a boardwalk leads down to the open shower and bathroom standing amid a coconut forest.</span></p>
<p><a class="button" href="stay/beach-hut">More</a></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="taipan-contentpanel-panelset-0-panel-6" class="taipan-contentpanel-panel bg-image-text-right">
  <div class="panel-background-image"  style="background-image: url('files/media/thumbcache/061/ad9/e50/Lighthouse.PNG');"></div>
  <div class="panel-constrain">
    <div class="panel-block">
      <div class="panel-cell">
<h2>The Light-House<br />Hut</h2>
<p>As the Light-House is still in developement please contact or fill out a booking form requesting further information.</p>
<p><a class="button" href="stay/lighthouse">More</a></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
